verdict.rationale: Navan's own pricing page documents managing expenses, issuing reimbursements and receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses. Its API covers manual expenses, repayments and per-transaction activity history, so the core submit-and-reimburse flow exists, but how payouts are delivered and tracked is not described. Missing for 10: evidence of payout by direct deposit, any stated reimbursement turnaround in days, employee-facing status tracking from submission to payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout

citations.quote: Retrieve and update Navan card transactions, Connect card transactions, manual expenses, payroll, repayments
